title: Find out about the Loose-fill Asbestos Program
summary: Find out if you are eligible for assistance through the NSW Government's Loose-fill Asbestos Program if you suspect loose-fill asbestos insulation in your home.
intro:
If you have loose-fill asbestos insulation in your home, you may be eligible for assistance through the NSW Government's Loose-fill Asbestos Program.

You should arrange private sample testing by a licensed asbestos assessor if you suspect your home has loose-fill asbestos insulation. In the meantime, avoid entering the ceiling space or drilling into walls.

If the testing shows that the home contains loose-fill asbestos insulation, you may be given the option to have your property demolished and remediated.

For more information visit loose-fill asbestos insulation –NSW Fair Trading.
who_can_apply: Having loose-fill asbestos insulation in your home
what_you_need: Arrange private sample testing by a licensed asbestos assessor if you suspect loose-fill asbestos insulation.
Avoid entering the ceiling space or drilling into walls while awaiting testing.
